title: Lightwave Logic, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Lightwave Logic, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its sales agreement with Roth Capital Partners to increase the aggregate at-the-market (ATM) share offering capacity to $51,404,500. The company has already sold 8,079,319 shares for gross proceeds of approximately $35 million under the existing agreement.
